text: Based on the Earth-observation data, there is **no evidence of fire** on the asset (ASSET-F02) during the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24). No thermal anomalies were detected by NASA FIRMS (MODIS or VIIRS sensors) within the asset boundary. However, the last day (2026-10-25) was not covered due to a data gap, so we cannot confirm the absence of fire on that specific day. Small, short, or cloud-obscured fires may also have gone undetected.
